jobs.title: Principal Product Manager (Technology)
jobs.description:
Posting Date
10/06/2026

2000 16th Street, Denver, Colorado, 80202, United States of America

Role Summary
You will lead product strategy and execution for DaVita’s Corporate Systems and Atlas Digital Transformation platforms—partnering closely with business and enterprise function leaders across the Village to identify the right problems to solve, run rigorous discovery and research, and deliver simple, high-impact digital solutions that streamline operations and elevate the teammate experience.

This role is equal parts product discovery leader, strategic advisor, and outcomes owner, operating with a human-centered mindset, strong business architecture acumen, and cross-functional leadership across complex enterprise platforms.

What You’ll Do (Core Responsibilities)
Own the Product Direction and Outcomes
- Set a clear product vision and strategy for Corporate Systems within the Atlas ecosystem, aligned to business Multi-Year Objectives (MYOs) and measurable Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).
- Build and maintain a transparent roadmap connecting enterprise business lane goals to prioritized product work (what we will do—and what we won’t do).
- Define success metrics, establish measurement plans, and leverage data and continuous user feedback to calibrate priorities over time.

Lead Discovery the "Right Way" (Research, Design, Problem Framing)
- Partner with UX/Design, engineering, and corporate business stakeholders to deeply understand user workflows, operational pain points, and systemic root causes (moving beyond reactive feature requests to true problem discovery).
- Run discovery activities including end-user shadowing, workflow observation, journey mapping, hypothesis testing, and rapid validation experiments.
- Facilitate structured working sessions and design workshops that produce clear decisions, trade-offs, and actionable delivery plans.

Be an Objective Strategic Partner Across Corporate Functions
- Build strong, trusted relationships across corporate business leadership and adjacent partners (including IT/Engineering, Architecture, Finance, People Services, Legal, Compliance, and Change Management).
- Bring an "outside-in" perspective—industry best practices, modern product thinking, and user empathy—to help leaders solve the most impactful strategic problems, not just the loudest ones.
- Create clarity in ambiguous spaces: align stakeholders on the "why," define what good looks like, and drive consensus and decision-making forward.

Drive Delivery Through Cross-Functional Leadership
- Partner with engineering, solutions architecture, integration teams, and external technology vendors to translate validated problems into clear product requirements, user stories, sequencing, and delivery roadmaps.
- Own backlog prioritization and trade-offs, keeping delivery squads focused on measurable business outcomes rather than output volume.
- Lead end-to-end launch readiness: change enablement, operational job aids/training, rollout communications, feedback loops, and post-launch adoption measurement.

Governance, Investment, and Operational Rigor
- Manage product operating rhythms: quarterly planning, roadmap reviews, portfolio progress reporting, and executive steering updates.
- Lead investment and value conversations for your product area, including business case development, benefit sizing, capacity alignment, and trade-off analysis.

What Success Looks Like (Simple, Measurable)
- Strategic Partnership: Business lane leaders consistently say: "This team helps us solve the right problems and gets us to measurable business outcomes faster."
- Operational Impact: Corporate system and platform enhancements measurably reduce friction, streamline critical workflows, and improve the teammate experience (tracked via agreed OKRs/KPIs).
- Clarity & Transparency: The Atlas product roadmap is focused, prioritized, and transparent—teams and executive leaders can clearly articulate what is being delivered and why, in plain language.

What You’ll Bring (Qualifications)
Required
- 8+ years of experience in product management (or closely related product leadership), including substantial experience leading product discovery and delivering meaningful enterprise product outcomes.
- Strong track record of partnering with cross-functional business leaders and technical teams to translate complex business problems into high-impact digital solutions.
- Demonstrated strength in problem framing, prioritization, stakeholder management, executive influence, and clear communication.
- Proven experience designing and facilitating structured working sessions, journey mapping, and workshops that yield actionable decisions.

Preferred
- Experience with enterprise packaged applications, SaaS platforms, and corporate systems ecosystems (e.g., Workday, Salesforce, Oracle/ERP platforms, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise tools).
- Experience leading product strategy and modernization within large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
- Experience operating in complex, highly regulated environments where data privacy, risk management, and compliance governance matter.
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

Work Model & Location:
This role offers a flexible work arrangement with a strong preference for candidates based near one of our Central Business Office (CBO) locations to work in a hybrid capacity (combining collaborative in-office days with remote flexibility).

For highly qualified candidates outside of our CBO hubs, a fully remote arrangement will be considered, provided you are willing and able to travel periodically (up to 30% / as business needs require) for key leadership meetings, team collaboration, and operational reviews.

What We’ll Provide:
More than just pay, our DaVita Rewards package connects teammates to what matters most. Teammates are eligible to begin receiving benefits on the first day of the month following or coinciding with one month of continuous employment. Below are some of our benefit offerings.
- Comprehensive benefits:  Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, paid time off, PTO cash out
- Support for you and your family:  Family resources, EAP counseling sessions, access Headspace®, backup child and elder care, maternity/paternity leave and more
- Professional development programs:  DaVita offers a variety of programs to help strong performers grow within their career and also offers on-demand virtual leadership and development courses through DaVita’s online training platform StarLearning.

jobs.description:
Posting Date
09/30/2026

2000 16th St, Denver, Colorado, 80202, United States of America

At DaVita, we are building an end-to-end kidney platform that connects care for individuals at every stage along their health journey—from earlier diagnosis and prevention, through supporting the transplant process, to ensuring patients are supported at home, in our centers, and in the hospital.

Our technology team plays a vital role in advancing DaVita’s kidney care platform—and we're growing! We’re looking for a Product Manager, Revenue Cycle to lead the product strategy and execution for our revenue cycle capabilities within our DaVita Integrated Kidney Care (DaVita IKC) organization. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, developing, and launching products that will transform our operations.

Responsibilities:
·       Define and Execute Product Strategy : Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for revenue cycle initiatives, from discovery and requirements gathering to launch and post-launch monitoring and optimization. Effectively translate the product strategy into a product roadmap that drives business outcomes and value delivery.
·       Identify and Prioritize High-Impact Use Cases : Using data and customer insights, work closely with users and stakeholders to identify and prioritize impactful opportunities that advance our objectives.
·       Translate Business Needs into Solutions: Translate customer needs and technical insights into clear and concise product specifications and requirements that articulate user stories, functionality, and technical constraints.
·       Manage Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with revenue cycle operations teams, engineering, Epic analysts, compliance, and clinical teams to build, test, and deploy solutions that deliver value. Ensure solutions are compliant, safe, accurate, reliable, and integrated seamlessly into our platforms.
·       Monitor and Measure Success : Define and analyze Objectives & Key Results (OKRs) to measure the impact and success of products, using data to inform future iterations and roadmap.
·       Manage Vendor Relationships: Manage the vendor relationships of the products within our revenue cycle digital portfolio. Hold vendors accountable to SLAs and drive resolution of defects that impact revenue cycle operations.

Qualifications
- Education : Bachelor's degree; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
- Product Management : 3+ years of experience as a product manager, or related, with a strong track record of leading successful software products.
- Strategic & Analytical Thinking: The ability to think big picture and translate complex, ambiguous problems into a clear product roadmap with measurable outcomes.
- Communication and Influence : Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and inspire others.
- Healthcare Industry Knowledge: Experience with the healthcare industry and the revenue cycle technology used within, including coding and billing processes. Knowledge of chronic disease management and risk adjustment is a plus.

- Professional development programs: DaVita offers a variety of programs to help strong performers grow within their career and also offers on-demand virtual leadership and development courses through DaVita’s online training platform StarLearning.

jobs.description:
Posting Date
10/06/2026

2000 16th St, Denver, Colorado, 80202-5117, United States of America

Position Overview

As a Product Analyst on Team Inventa within Revenue Operations (ROPS), you will play a critical role in driving innovation at the intersection of business, technology, and clinical practices. Team Inventa acts as the comprehensive product group for DaVita’s Field Revenue Operations; owning core workflow applications and connecting business operations with IT development.
This position focuses on continuously evolving our admissions and insurance management workflow applications, external referral portals, and patient engagement tools. The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of business acumen and technical fluency, acting as a liaison between operational stakeholders and software engineering teams. You will analyze user needs, co-create application requirements, facilitate the software development lifecycle, and ensure our technology creates the most efficient and seamless experience for our teammates, field partners, and patients.

- Open to remote candidates- Travel 2x per year is expected

- CO candidates near Denver - Onsite presence is required 1x week as needed at our HQ in Denver, CO

Responsibilities:
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- Discovery Lead: Lead upstream discovery efforts, conduct systematic value vetting, and assess the ROI and business impact of proposed changes to ensure alignment with business goals.
- Data Driven: Leverage data analysis and direct user feedback to inform product decisions, translating complex insights into compelling narratives and actionable recommendations.
- System & Tech Orientation: Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on system interactions, creating detailed process maps and understanding how data capture and processes across multiple systems are interrelated.
- Ops / UAT Driver: Drive operational readiness and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by facilitating user studies, focus groups, and championing the Voice of the Customer (VOC).
- Solution Mindset: Conduct root-cause analysis on system issues and translate complex challenges into clear technical requirements. Identify alternative operational workarounds when ideal technology solutions are delayed.
- Communications & Facilitation: Act as the primary change management driver. Effectively lead working sessions (e.g., requirement reviews, status meetings) to ensure seamless handoffs, field readiness, and cross-functional alignment.
- Building Product Expertise: Develop deep, product-specific expertise and take comprehensive ownership of the ongoing value delivered to the operations teams and end-users.

Minimum Qualifications

- High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
- Minimum of two (2) years’ experience in product analysis, business systems analysis, software product management, or a related field.
- Experience operating within Agile/Scrum environments and familiarity with the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
- Proficiency in digital product management and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Visio, Lucidchart).
- Proficiency in analytical tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, Tableau) preferred.
- Resourceful and agile with a drive to investigate problems; proven ability to successfully navigate an autonomous work environment.
- Experience with user testing, QA collaboration, and facilitating User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts to diverse audiences and create executive-level documentation.
- Experience in healthcare, revenue cycle, or enterprise-level initiatives preferred.
